_comment: Files mirrored from the hub. Paths are identical on both sides; the baseline copy lives at .upstream/<path>. Adding a watched file is one line here plus its baseline copy (node scripts/check-upstream-drift.mjs --update fetches it).
_notWatched: rules/*.mdc is deliberately excluded. MVDS's rules are effectively rewritten against AGENTS.md (figma.mdc ~117 changed lines, openspec-workflow.mdc ~80, github-workflow.mdc ~61) — watching them would report divergence we chose on purpose, every run, forever.
